protocol_revisions.description: Serve the legacy initialize handshake and modern revision, with legacy lists omitting cache hints and modern lists marked private with zero TTL.

capability_binding.description: Overlapping requests retain their own client capabilities on both handler and reusable-options paths.

roots_isolation.description: Roots and Current never expose another client's roots; normal handler calls resolve Current and reusable-options Current remains empty until that request fetches.

notification_lifetime.description: Closing one session preserves surviving-session routing notifications; legacy broadcasts and modern subscription filtering remain correct.

modern_state_invariance.description: Modern discovery does not change after session-state writes or soft-root changes.

modern_capability_discovery.description: Modern discovery neutralizes roots, sampling, elicitation and feedback capabilities and roots data, without making a roots round-trip.

advertised_execution.description: Advertised capability-gated commands remain callable with the real client; commands excluded by the fixed predicate remain absent, and call answers cannot retract a tool.

launch_globals_and_cleanup.description: Tool sub-invocations preserve launch globals and release their temporary session registrations on completion.

catalog_rebuild_retry.description: A failed modern catalog rebuild surfaces an error without serving per-session stale catalogs; a later request retries without another invalidation.

legacy_dynamic_catalog.description: Legacy capability-, session-state- and soft-root-gated discovery retains its dynamic semantics.

bootstrap_and_request_era.description: Legacy discover/call bootstrap is per session; modern requests always see the real catalog; one connection can carry both eras.

concurrent_output.description: Concurrent sessions retain their tools and command output.

roots_coalescing.description: Overlapping first calls coalesce a native roots fetch and repeated lookups within a reusable-options request issue only one round-trip.

roots_invalidation.description: Completed and in-flight roots invalidation force fresh data; a retired response is neither cached nor returned to a waiting caller.

roots_failure_retry.description: Failed roots lookups permit later retries even after the last waiter leaves; Current falls back to configured soft roots.

roots_cancellation.description: A caller waiting for roots is released by its own cancellation token.

feedback_routing.description: Modern requests without log levels carry feedback in results; declared thresholds and legacy notifications preserve severity and progress semantics.

prompt_and_resource_feedback.description: Feedback survives successful prompts and failed prompts, resource reads and UI resources, without contaminating successful raw UI bodies.

exception_privacy.description: Uncaught handler, dependency factory and binding callback exception details stay private; deliberate application error text and binder diagnostics remain visible.

explicit_prompt_metadata.description: Explicit prompts retain metadata, content and feedback, resolve roots, and copy every SDK GetPromptResult field.

apps_discovery_and_context.description: The apps extension remains advertised for capability/data gated or shadowed apps, and UI-resource capability calls use the requesting client.

preserved_mcp_behavior.description: Preserve command projection, resource/prompt/app mapping, fallback behavior, interaction capabilities, exit codes, subscriptions and routing refresh in the independent protocol regression suite.

adaptations: Own pinned test project; omit inspector/external executable tests and implementation-level unit tests.
Replace private protocol-constant references with protocol revision literals.
